tools.name: hubspot_search_deals
tools.description: Advanced search tool for HubSpot deals with support for: deal stage name filtering (e.g., 'Won', 'Shortlisted', 'Lead'), owner ID filtering, date field + range filtering (e.g., 'Q2 2024', '2024-06'), and rich results including owner info and associated contacts. Use this tool for complex searches with multiple criteria. For simple year-based queries, prefer getDealsByYearTool.

stage_names.description: Deal stage names to filter by (e.g., ['Won', 'Shortlisted', 'closedwon']). Use 'Won' or 'closedwon' for won deals.

owner_ids.description: HubSpot owner IDs to filter deals by specific owners

date_field.description: Date property to filter on - use 'closedate' for deal close dates, 'createdate' for creation dates, 'hs_lastmodifieddate' for last modified

date_str.description: Human-readable date range string for filtering (e.g., 'Q2 2024', '2024-06', 'last quarter'). Use with date_field parameter.

filters.description: Additional custom filter criteria for searching deals

properties.description: Properties to return for each deal (default includes dealname, amount, dealstage, closedate, hubspot_owner_id)

limit.description: Maximum number of deals to return (default: 100)

tools.name: hubspot_get_deals_by_owner
tools.description: Get deals owned by a specific user in a specific stage

limit.description: Maximum number of deals to return

tools.name: hubspot_get_won_deals
tools.description: Get won deals for a specific time period (quarter or year). Returns deals with AOT contact information. Use 'quarter' interval for quarterly analysis (e.g., 'Q2 2024', 'last quarter') or 'year' interval for annual analysis (e.g., '2024', '2023'). This is the recommended tool for finding won deals with flexible time-based filtering.

dateStr.description: Date/time period (e.g., 'Q2 2024', '2024', 'last quarter', '2023'). For quarters: 'Q1-Q4 YYYY' or 'last quarter'. For years: 'YYYY'.

interval.description: Time interval: 'quarter' for quarterly deals, 'year' for annual deals. Auto-detected from dateStr if not provided.

limit.description: Maximum number of won deals to return (default: 10 for quarters, 50 for years)

tools.name: hubspot_get_deals_by_year
tools.description: Get deals closed in a specific year (any stage). Use this tool when asked about 'deals closed in year X', or 'top deals of year X'. This is the primary tool for year-based deal queries.

tools.name: hubspot_search_companies
tools.description: Search for HubSpot companies by name, domain, or other properties. Always provide filters to search for specific companies. To find a company by exact name, you MUST use: filters.filterGroups[0].filters[0] with propertyName='name', operator='EQ', and the company name as value. For partial name match, use operator='CONTAINS'. Without filters, this returns a generic list of all companies.

filterGroups.description: Array of filter groups (OR logic between groups, AND logic within a group)

filters.description: Filter and sort criteria for searching companies. To search by company name, use: {filterGroups: [{filters: [{propertyName: 'name', operator: 'EQ', value: 'CompanyName'}]}]}

properties.description: Properties to return for each company. Default: ['name', 'domain', 'industry', 'city', 'state', 'country', 'hubspot_owner_id']. Other useful properties: phone, website, description, numberofemployees, annualrevenue

limit.description: Maximum number of companies to return (default: 100, max: 100)

after.description: Pagination cursor for next page of results

tools.name: hubspot_get_high_potential_prospects
tools.description: Get high-potential prospect COMPANIES (not deals) that have engaged with AOT via email activities during a specified period. Uses actual email activity counts to rank companies by engagement level. Use this for company analysis, not for finding won deals or deal information.

tools.name: hubspot_get_high_potential_prospects_by_meetings
tools.description: Get high-potential prospect COMPANIES based on meeting activities during a specified period. Uses actual meeting activity counts to rank companies by engagement level. Use this for company analysis based on meetings/calls, not emails.

tools.name: hubspot_get_company_recent_emails
tools.description: Get recent email communications for a specific company by name or ID. Shows the most recent emails including dates, subjects, and content. Use this to find when the last email communication happened with a company and what was discussed. You can provide either the company name or the company ID.

companyNameOrId.description: Company name OR HubSpot company ID. The tool will automatically search by name if not a valid ID.

limit.description: Number of recent emails to return (default: 10, max: 50)

daysBack.description: Number of days to look back for emails (default: 30, max: 365)

tools.name: hubspot_get_company_recent_meetings
tools.description: Get recent meetings for a specific company by name or ID. Shows the most recent meetings including dates, titles, outcomes, and notes. Use this to find when the last meeting happened with a company and what was discussed. You can provide either the company name or the company ID.

companyNameOrId.description: Company name OR HubSpot company ID. The tool will automatically search by name if not a valid ID.

limit.description: Number of recent meetings to return (default: 10, max: 50)

daysBack.description: Number of days to look back for meetings (default: 30, max: 365)

properties.description: Properties to return for each contact

limit.description: Maximum number of contacts to return

tools.name: hubspot_get_contact
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific contact

tools.name: hubspot_get_contacts_by_company
tools.description: Get contacts associated with a specific company

limit.description: Maximum number of contacts to return

tools.name: hubspot_search_email_campaigns
tools.description: Search for HubSpot email campaigns by name or other filters. Returns campaign details including sender information, open rates, and performance metrics.

name.description: Email campaign name to search for. This will search for campaigns with names containing this text. Use the exact campaign name for best results.

properties.description: Properties to return for each campaign. Default includes basic campaign properties like name, subject, state, type, and statistics.

limit.description: Maximum number of campaigns to return (default: 100)

after.description: Pagination cursor for next page of results

tools.name: hubspot_get_email_campaign
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific email campaign

tools.name: hubspot_get_campaign_metrics
tools.description: Get email campaign metrics including open rates by month

year.description: Year to get campaign metrics for

startDate.description: Start date for performance period (ISO format)

endDate.description: End date for performance period (ISO format)

tools.name: hubspot_get_email_statistics_histogram
tools.description: Retrieve time-series performance metrics for HubSpot email campaigns as a histogram. Returns aggregated campaign statistics (open rate, click rate, bounce rate) split across time intervals such as daily or monthly buckets.

dateStr.description: A flexible string representing the date range (e.g., '2025', 'Q1 2025', 'July 2025')

interval.description: Interval to split the histogram buckets by. Valid values: 'day', 'week', 'month', 'quarter' (default: 'month')
